_meta.description: Verified snapshot of the live MUSHI catalog. Prices are integer minor units (cents). Not a live sync — replace with Shopify data at integration.
notes: Live catalog listed 9 products on the verification date; no product had a compare-at price or more than the single default variant.
Exclusive MUSHI Fan ($27.00) is on the live catalog but was not in the brief's reference list.
The Figma comp shows $60.00 / $65.00 and SALE / POPULAR badges; those are not on the live site and are not used.
Chocolate short descriptions are the first sentence of the live description; the live homepage only carries short copy for gummies.
Four apparel products (merch) come from the Shop All comp, not the live catalog. They have no verified price, so price is null and they cannot be added to the cart. The comp's $60.00 is not used.
Floaty, Beach Ball and Fan are grouped as 'extras' per the Shop All comp; names and prices remain those of the live catalog.
`theme` is the background colour of each product's pack shot (sampled from the approved image); the product page fades from it.
Apparel `sizes` are placeholders until the real size run and stock are supplied.
Gummy `packaging` (nutrition facts, ingredients, storage, warning) is transcribed from the back-of-pack artwork supplied 2026-11-18. Chocolates have no panel yet.

products.title: Cherry
products.shortDescription: Bold cherry with a tart spark. A little bite, and ideas bloom.
products.fullDescription: Rich, bold, and irresistibly smooth. Our Cherry Mushroom-Infused Gummies combine the deep, juicy sweetness of ripe cherries with the natural benefits of mushrooms. Each gummy is crafted with premium, plant-based ingredients to support your well-being while delivering a deliciously tart and luscious cherry flavor.
products.flavorProfile: Sweet, slightly tart, and bursting with rich cherry goodness.
products.perfectFor: Relaxation, mental clarity, and everyday wellness.

packaging.warning: Keep out of reach of children. Use while pregnant or breastfeeding may be harmful. Consult with your healthcare provider before use. May cause drowsiness. Do not operate a vehicle or heavy machinery while using this product. Use responsibly.

products.title: Dark Chocolate
products.shortDescriptionSource: first sentence of the live product description
products.fullDescription: Rich, bold, and deeply satisfying. Our Mushroom-Infused Dark Chocolate deliver an intense cocoa experience with smooth, velvety depth and a refined finish. Crafted for those who appreciate pure chocolate flavor, each piece blends premium dark chocolate with the grounding benefits of functional mushrooms.
products.flavorProfile: Bold cocoa, slightly bittersweet, smooth and lingering.
products.perfectFor: Focus, balance, evening wind-down, and mindful indulgence.

products.title: Milk Chocolate
products.shortDescriptionSource: first sentence of the live product description
products.fullDescription: Creamy, comforting, and luxuriously smooth. Our Mushroom-Infused Milk Chocolate offers a silky, melt-in-your-mouth experience with a perfectly balanced sweetness. The rich dairy notes harmonize beautifully with our mushroom blend, creating a deliciously uplifting treat that feels both nostalgic and nourishing.
products.flavorProfile: Creamy, sweet, and velvety with a soft cocoa finish.
products.perfectFor: Everyday enjoyment, gentle mood support, and a feel-good treat.

products.title: Midnight Berry
products.shortDescriptionSource: first sentence of the live product description
products.fullDescription: Decadent, vibrant, and irresistibly layered. Our Mushroom Infused Dark Chocolate with Berry Filling combine rich dark cocoa with a luscious burst of bright berry at the center. Beneath the smooth chocolate shell lies a vibrant, fruit-forward filling, perfectly balanced and elevated with the wellness benefits of mushrooms.
products.flavorProfile: Bold dark chocolate, bright berry tang, smooth and balanced finish.
products.perfectFor: Elevated indulgence, creative moments, and a sophisticated sweet escape.
